verdict.rationale: IRCC runs its own public processing-times checker where you select your application type to see how long processing will take. It also publishes its method: times reflect how long it took to process 80% of that application type in the past. This directly delivers service-published processing times per transaction type. Missing for 10: evidence that the founder-specific Start-up Visa route is listed in the checker, times that are current or live rather than historical 80th-percentile figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
